<!--
Normal development pull requests target the protected dev branch.

Create feature, fix, refactor, and documentation branches from a clean,
synchronized dev branch and return them to dev through a pull request.

The protected main branch receives changes only through the controlled
dev-to-main promotion workflow. Do not target main directly for normal
development work.

Prefer the repository Makefile targets for branch creation, validation,
pull-request creation, promotion, release, and deployment workflows.

See docs/fork.md for the complete development and release model.
-->
